headline: Dhaka ranks world's second most polluted city on Monday
summary: Air quality in the capital has plummeted to 'unhealthy' levels, with surrounding areas like Savar and Tongi seeing even worse pollution.
details: According to IQAir, Dhaka's air quality index (AQI) hit 185 on Monday morning, placing it as the second most polluted city globally. Only New Delhi, India, with an AQI of 308, ranked higher.
caption:
Dhaka is now the second most polluted city in the world.

According to IQAir, Dhaka's air quality index (AQI) hit 185 on Monday morning, placing it as the second most polluted city globally. Only New Delhi, India, with an AQI of 308, ranked higher.

headline_marked: Pritom Hasan and Shahtaj Monira [[announce end of marriage]]
headline: Pritom Hasan and Shahtaj Monira announce end of marriage
summary: The singer and actress, who married in 2022, stated they are parting ways due to a lack of mutual understanding after ten years together.
details: Singer and actor Pritom Hasan and actress Shahtaj Monira Hashem have announced the end of their marriage on mutual understanding.
The couple shared the news on their Facebook pages on Sunday night, stating that a divorce process is now under way.
In a joint statement, they revealed the a decision came after long deliberation, lengthy discussion, and with the support and consent of both families.
The pair noted that while they remain grateful for the memories shared over ten years together, they realized they are better off going separate ways due to a lack of mutual understanding.
They have requested fans, friends, and the media to respect their privacy and feelings as they enter this new chapter of their lives.
The couple married on October 28, 2022, in Sreemangal, after meeting while working on the music video for the song 'Jadukor'.
Pritom Hasan is the son of the late singer Khaled Hasan Milu and is known for hits like 'Local Bus' and 'Beainshab'.
Shahtaj Monira Hashem rose to fame through her acting in the music video 'Shudhu Tomar Jonno'.
caption:
Pritom Hasan and Shahtaj Monira are parting ways. The couple announced their divorce on Sunday night.

Singer and actor Pritom Hasan and actress Shahtaj Monira Hashem have announced the end of their marriage on mutual understanding.

The couple shared the news on their Facebook pages on Sunday night, stating that a divorce process is now under way.

In a joint statement, they revealed the a decision came after long deliberation, lengthy discussion, and with the support and consent of both families.

The pair noted that while they remain grateful for the memories shared over ten years together, they realized they are better off going separate ways due to a lack of mutual understanding.

They have requested fans, friends, and the media to respect their privacy and feelings as they enter this new chapter of their lives.

The couple married on October 28, 2022, in Sreemangal, after meeting while working on the music video for the song 'Jadukor'.

Pritom Hasan is the son of the late singer Khaled Hasan Milu and is known for hits like 'Local Bus' and 'Beainshab'.

Shahtaj Monira Hashem rose to fame through her acting in the music video 'Shudhu Tomar Jonno'.
